targets.rawSQL: SELECT model, count(*) as responses, sum(cast(input_tokens as bigint)) as input_tokens, sum(cast(output_tokens as bigint)) as output_tokens, sum(cast(cache_read_tokens as bigint)) as cache_read, sum(cast(cache_creation_tokens as bigint)) as cache_write FROM ${athena_database}.logs WHERE year BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) AND year * 10000 + month * 100 + day BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) * 10000 + month($__timeFrom()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) * 10000 + month($__timeTo()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeTo()) AND event_name = 'codex.sse_event' AND input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND model IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model ORDER BY responses DESC

targets.rawSQL: SELECT substr(session_id, 1, 12) as conversation, count(*) as responses, sum(cast(input_tokens as bigint)) + sum(cast(output_tokens as bigint)) as total_tokens, sum(cast(input_tokens as bigint)) as input_tokens, sum(cast(output_tokens as bigint)) as output_tokens, sum(cast(cache_read_tokens as bigint)) as cache_read FROM ${athena_database}.logs WHERE year BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) AND year * 10000 + month * 100 + day BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) * 10000 + month($__timeFrom()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) * 10000 + month($__timeTo()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeTo()) AND event_name = 'codex.sse_event' AND input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY total_tokens DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Recent Codex Conversations
panels.description: Codex CLI events (service_name codex_*). A conversation is one Codex session: its conversation.id is stored as session_id.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT substr(session_id, 1, 12) as conversation, model, terminal_type, count(*) as events, min(event_timestamp) as started, max(event_timestamp) as last_activity FROM ${athena_database}.logs WHERE year BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) AND year * 10000 + month * 100 + day BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) * 10000 + month($__timeFrom()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) * 10000 + month($__timeTo()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeTo()) AND service_name LIKE 'codex%' AND session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session_id, model, terminal_type ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT tool_name, count_if(event_name = 'codex.tool_result') as calls, count_if(event_name = 'codex.tool_decision' AND decision LIKE 'approved%') as approved, count_if(event_name = 'codex.tool_decision' AND decision NOT LIKE 'approved%') as not_approved, round(avg(CASE WHEN event_name = 'codex.tool_result' THEN try_cast(duration_ms as double) END), 0) as avg_ms FROM ${athena_database}.logs WHERE year BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) AND year * 10000 + month * 100 + day BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) * 10000 + month($__timeFrom()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) * 10000 + month($__timeTo()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeTo()) AND event_name IN ('codex.tool_decision', 'codex.tool_result') AND tool_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT event_name, count(*) as events FROM ${athena_database}.logs WHERE year BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) AND year * 10000 + month * 100 + day BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) * 10000 + month($__timeFrom()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) * 10000 + month($__timeTo()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeTo()) AND service_name LIKE 'codex%' AND event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY events DESC

panels.title: Codex API Errors
panels.description: Codex CLI events (service_name codex_*). Failed codex.api_request calls (non-2xx status or an error) and failed stream events.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT event_timestamp, event_name, substr(session_id, 1, 12) as conversation, model, status_code, error, duration_ms FROM ${athena_database}.logs WHERE year BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) AND year * 10000 + month * 100 + day BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()) * 10000 + month($__timeFrom()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeFrom()) AND year($__timeTo()) * 10000 + month($__timeTo()) * 100 + day_of_month($__timeTo()) AND event_name IN ('codex.api_request', 'codex.sse_event') AND (error IS NOT NULL OR status_code NOT LIKE '2%') ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
